title: Plasma Calendar widget should gain the ability to show PIM events, like the Digital Clock can do
line: The Calendar widget can now use the same calendar add-ons as the Digital Clock (holidays, astronomical events, PIM events…) and lists the selected day's events.
explanation: The standalone Calendar widget never created an EventPluginsManager and had no enabledCalendarPlugins setting, so calendar add-ons (PIM events from kdepim-addons, holidays, astronomical events, alternate calendars) could only be used in the Digital Clock's popup. The widget now has the same add-on list in its General settings page (with each enabled add-on's own settings page, like the Digital Clock), passes the manager to MonthView so days get event dots and holiday labels, and shows an events list for the selected day: below the month when the widget is narrow or in a panel popup, beside it when the widget is wide. Because calendar add-ons are process-wide plugin singletons, a second calendar loading the same month made the first one show every event twice; DaysModel now ignores events it already has for that day.

commits.message:
applets/calendar: Show events from calendar add-ons

Unlike the Digital Clock, the Calendar widget couldn't use calendar
add-ons, so it never showed events. It now offers the same add-ons and
lists the selected day's events, ignoring copies other calendars load.

BUG: 474063

From 1aced2be57efb913ab3ac8ba088c57b5873176f8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 22:01:10 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/calendar: Show events from calendar add-ons

Unlike the Digital Clock, the Calendar widget couldn't use calendar
add-ons, so it never showed events. It now offers the same add-ons and
lists the selected day's events, ignoring copies other calendars load.

BUG: 474063

     SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-KDE-Accepted-GPL
 */
 
+pragma ComponentBehavior: Bound
+
 import QtQuick
 
+import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
 import org.kde.plasma.configuration
+import org.kde.plasma.workspace.calendar as PlasmaCalendar
 
 ConfigModel {
+    id: configModel
+
     ConfigCategory {
          name: i18n("General")
          icon: "preferences-desktop-plasma"
          source: "configGeneral.qml"
     }
+
+    readonly property PlasmaCalendar.EventPluginsManager eventPluginsManager: PlasmaCalendar.EventPluginsManager {
+        Component.onCompleted: {
+            populateEnabledPluginsList(Plasmoid.configuration.enabledCalendarPlugins);
+        }
+    }
+
+    readonly property Instantiator __eventPlugins: Instantiator {
+        model: configModel.eventPluginsManager.model
+        delegate: ConfigCategory {
+            required property string display
+            required property string decoration
+            required property string configUi
+            required property string configModule
+            required property string configComponent
+            required property string pluginId
+
+            name: display
+            icon: decoration
+            source: configUi
+
+            configUiModule: configModule
+            configUiComponent: configComponent
+            visible: Plasmoid.configuration.enabledCalendarPlugins.indexOf(pluginId) > -1
+        }
+
+        onObjectAdded: (index, object) => configModel.appendCategory(object)
+        onObjectRemoved: (index, object) => configModel.removeCategory(object)
+    }
 }

diff --git a/applets/calendar/qml/main.qml b/applets/calendar/qml/main.qml
index c536afd1ca..60b4a1b527 100644
--- a/applets/calendar/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/calendar/qml/main.qml
@@ -13,6 +13,7 @@ import QtQuick.Layouts
 import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
 import org.kde.plasma.clock

@@ -108,10 +109,18 @@ PlasmoidItem {
     }
 
     fullRepresentation: Item {
+        id: fullRoot
+
+        readonly property bool showAgenda: eventPluginsManager.enabledPlugins.length > 0
+        // Put the events next to the calendar when there is room for both, otherwise below it
+        readonly property bool agendaBeside: showAgenda && height > 0 && width >= height * 1.5

-        readonly property int _minimumHeight: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 14

+        readonly property int _stackedMonthViewMinimumHeight: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 20

@@ -126,12 +135,274 @@ PlasmoidItem {

-        MonthView {

+        EventPluginsManager {

+        GridLayout {
             anchors.fill: parent

+            rowSpacing: 0

+
+            MonthView {

+            }
+
+            KSvg.SvgItem {
+                visible: fullRoot.showAgenda
+
+                Layout.fillWidth: !fullRoot.agendaBeside
+                Layout.fillHeight: fullRoot.agendaBeside

+                Layout.preferredHeight: naturalSize.height
+
+                imagePath: "widgets/line"
+                elementId: fullRoot.agendaBeside ? "vertical-line" : "horizontal-line"
+            }
+
+            ColumnLayout {
+                id: agenda
+                visible: fullRoot.showAgenda
+                spacing: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+
+                Layout.fillWidth: true
+                Layout.fillHeight: true
+                Layout.preferredWidth: fullRoot.agendaBeside ? fullRoot.width / 2 : -1
+                Layout.topMargin: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+
+                function formatDateWithoutYear(date: date): string {
+                    // Same as in the digital clock: there is no locale-aware
+                    // day-and-month-only date format, so strip the year
+                    const format = Qt.locale().dateFormat(Locale.ShortFormat).replace(/[./ ]*Y{2,4}[./ ]*/i, '');
+                    return Qt.formatDate(date, format);
+                }
+
+                function dateEquals(date1: date, date2: date): bool {
+                    // QDate is exposed to QML as midnight UTC, while MonthView's
+                    // current date is constructed in the local time zone.
+                    return date1.getUTCFullYear() === date2.getFullYear()
+                        && date1.getUTCMonth() === date2.getMonth()
+                        && date1.getUTCDate() === date2.getDate();
+                }
+
+                function updateEventsForCurrentDate() {
+                    eventsList.model = calendar.daysModel.eventsForDate(calendar.currentDate);
+                }
+
+                Connections {
+                    target: calendar
+
+                    function onCurrentDateChanged() {
+                        agenda.updateEventsForCurrentDate();
+                    }
+                }
+
+                Connections {
+                    target: calendar.daysModel
+
+                    function onAgendaUpdated(updatedDate: date) {
+                        if (agenda.dateEquals(updatedDate, calendar.currentDate)) {
+                            agenda.updateEventsForCurrentDate();
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+
+                TextMetrics {
+                    id: dateLabelMetrics
+
+                    // Date/time are arbitrary values with all parts being two-digit
+                    readonly property string timeString: Qt.formatTime(new Date(2000, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12))
+                    readonly property string dateString: agenda.formatDateWithoutYear(new Date(2000, 12, 12, 12, 12, 12))
+
+                    font: Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont

+                }
+
+                Kirigami.Heading {
+                    Layout.fillWidth: true
+                    Layout.leftMargin: Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing
+                    Layout.rightMargin: Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing
+
+                    level: 2
+                    text: calendar.currentDate.toLocaleDateString(Qt.locale(), Locale.LongFormat)
+                    textFormat: Text.PlainText
+                    elide: Text.ElideRight
+                }
+
+                PlasmaComponents3.Label {
+                    visible: calendar.currentDateAuxilliaryText.length > 0
+
+                    Layout.fillWidth: true
+                    Layout.leftMargin: Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing
+                    Layout.rightMargin: Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing
+
+                    font.pixelSize: Kirigami.Theme.smallFont.pixelSize
+                    text: calendar.currentDateAuxilliaryText
+                    textFormat: Text.PlainText
+                }
+
+                Item {
+                    Layout.fillWidth: true
+                    Layout.fillHeight: true
+
+                    PlasmaComponents3.ScrollView {
+                        id: eventsView
+                        anchors.fill: parent
+
+                        ListView {
+                            id: eventsList
+
+                            activeFocusOnTab: true
+                            highlight: null
+                            currentIndex: -1
+
+                            onCurrentIndexChanged: if (!activeFocus) {
+                                currentIndex = -1;
+                            }
+
+                            onActiveFocusChanged: currentIndex = activeFocus ? 0 : -1
+
+                            delegate: PlasmaComponents3.ItemDelegate {
+                                id: eventItem
+
+                                // Crashes if the type is declared as eventData (which is Q_GADGET)
+                                required property /*PlasmaCalendar.eventData*/var modelData
+
+                                width: ListView.view.width
+
+                                leftPadding: Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing
+
+                                text: eventTitle.text
+                                hoverEnabled: true
+                                highlighted: ListView.isCurrentItem
+                                Accessible.description: modelData.description
+                                readonly property bool hasTime: {
+                                    // Explicitly all-day event
+                                    if (modelData.isAllDay) {
+                                        return false;
+                                    }
+                                    // Multi-day event which does not start or end on the selected day
+                                    if (modelData.startDateTime - calendar.currentDate < 0 &&
+                                        modelData.endDateTime - calendar.currentDate > 86400000) { // 24hrs in ms
+                                        return false;
+                                    }
+
+                                    // Non-explicit all-day event
+                                    const startIsMidnight = modelData.startDateTime.getHours() === 0
+                                        && modelData.startDateTime.getMinutes() === 0;
+
+                                    const endIsMidnight = modelData.endDateTime.getHours() === 0
+                                        && modelData.endDateTime.getMinutes() === 0;
+
+                                    const sameDay = modelData.startDateTime.getDate() === modelData.endDateTime.getDate()
+                                        && modelData.startDateTime.getDay() === modelData.endDateTime.getDay();
+
+                                    return !(startIsMidnight && endIsMidnight && sameDay);
+                                }
+
+                                contentItem: GridLayout {
+                                    columns: 3
+                                    rows: 2
+                                    rowSpacing: 0
+                                    columnSpacing: Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing
+
+                                    Rectangle {
+                                        Layout.row: 0
+                                        Layout.column: 0
+                                        Layout.rowSpan: 2
+                                        Layout.fillHeight: true
+
+                                        color: eventItem.modelData.eventColor
+                                        implicitWidth: 5
+                                        visible: eventItem.modelData.eventColor !== ""
+                                    }
+
+                                    PlasmaComponents3.Label {
+                                        readonly property bool startsToday: eventItem.modelData.startDateTime - calendar.currentDate >= 0
+                                        readonly property bool startedYesterdayLessThan12HoursAgo: eventItem.modelData.startDateTime - calendar.currentDate >= -43200000 //12hrs in ms
+
+                                        Layout.row: 0
+                                        Layout.column: 1
+                                        Layout.minimumWidth: dateLabelMetrics.width
+
+                                        text: startsToday || startedYesterdayLessThan12HoursAgo
+                                            ? Qt.formatTime(eventItem.modelData.startDateTime)
+                                            : agenda.formatDateWithoutYear(eventItem.modelData.startDateTime)
+                                        textFormat: Text.PlainText
+                                        horizontalAlignment: Qt.AlignRight
+                                        visible: eventItem.hasTime
+                                    }
+
+                                    PlasmaComponents3.Label {
+                                        readonly property bool endsToday: eventItem.modelData.endDateTime - calendar.currentDate <= 86400000 // 24hrs in ms
+                                        readonly property bool endsTomorrowInLessThan12Hours: eventItem.modelData.endDateTime - calendar.currentDate <= 86400000 + 43200000 // 36hrs in ms
+
+                                        Layout.row: 1
+                                        Layout.column: 1
+                                        Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignTop
+                                        Layout.minimumWidth: dateLabelMetrics.width
+
+                                        text: endsToday || endsTomorrowInLessThan12Hours
+                                            ? Qt.formatTime(eventItem.modelData.endDateTime)
+                                            : agenda.formatDateWithoutYear(eventItem.modelData.endDateTime)
+                                        textFormat: Text.PlainText
+                                        horizontalAlignment: Qt.AlignRight
+                                        opacity: 0.75
+                                        visible: eventItem.hasTime
+                                    }
+
+                                    Kirigami.SelectableLabel {
+                                        id: eventTitle
+
+                                        Layout.row: 0
+                                        Layout.column: 2
+                                        Layout.fillWidth: true
+
+                                        text: eventItem.modelData.title
+                                        textFormat: Text.PlainText
+                                        verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
+                                        wrapMode: Text.Wrap
+                                    }
+
+                                    Kirigami.SelectableLabel {
+                                        Layout.row: 1
+                                        Layout.column: 2
+                                        Layout.fillWidth: true
+
+                                        visible: text.length > 0
+                                        text: eventItem.modelData.description
+                                        wrapMode: Text.Wrap
+
+                                        onLinkActivated: link => Qt.openUrlExternally(link)
+                                    }
+                                }
+                            }
+                        }
+                    }
+
+                    PlasmaExtras.PlaceholderMessage {
+                        anchors.centerIn: eventsView
+                        width: eventsView.width - (Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 4)

+                            : i18n("No events for this day")
+                    }
+                }
+            }
         }

diff --git a/components/calendar/daysmodel.cpp b/components/calendar/daysmodel.cpp

--- a/components/calendar/daysmodel.cpp
+++ b/components/calendar/daysmodel.cpp
@@ -198,12 +198,24 @@ void DaysModel::onDataReady(const QMultiHash<QDate, CalendarEvents::EventData> &
     for (int i = 0; i < d->data->count(); i++) {
         const DayData &currentData = d->data->at(i);
         const QDate currentDate(currentData.yearNumber, currentData.monthNumber, currentData.dayNumber);
-        if (!data.values(currentDate).isEmpty()) {
-            const int addedEventCount = data.values(currentDate).count();
+        // Plugins are shared by all calendars in the process, so events loaded for
+        // another calendar showing the same days arrive here as well
+        const QList<CalendarEvents::EventData> knownEvents = d->eventsData.values(currentDate);
+        QList<CalendarEvents::EventData> newEvents;
+        for (const auto &event : data.values(currentDate)) {
+            const bool known = std::ranges::any_of(knownEvents, [&event](const CalendarEvents::EventData &knownEvent) {
+                return knownEvent.uid() == event.uid() && knownEvent.title() == event.title() && knownEvent.startDateTime() == event.startDateTime()
+                    && knownEvent.endDateTime() == event.endDateTime();
+            });
+            if (!known) {
+                newEvents.append(event);
+            }
+        }
 
+        if (!newEvents.isEmpty()) {
             // Add event
-            beginInsertRows(index(i, 0), 0, addedEventCount - 1);
-            for (const auto &dataDay : data.values(currentDate)) {
+            beginInsertRows(index(i, 0), 0, newEvents.count() - 1);
+            for (const auto &dataDay : std::as_const(newEvents)) {
                 d->eventsData.insert(currentDate, dataDay);
             }
             endInsertRows();

media.caption: Calendar widget on the desktop on master: no events, holidays or moon phases
With the Holidays (United States) and Astronomical Events add-ons: event dots and holiday labels in the month, and the selected day's events below it
Calendar widget settings on master: no calendar add-ons
Settings now list the calendar add-ons; enabled ones get their own settings page in the sidebar
A wide Calendar widget shows the events beside the month, like the Digital Clock's popup
Calendar widget in the panel: the popup shows the events below the month and opens above the panel
